name: Sheet Metal Solutions, LLC
old_description: At SMS we take care to provide our customers with high quality services and products that are personalized for their unique needs. Our highly trained staff members are professional, courteous, & effective.​ We are very flexible and can often accommodate special situations.
about:
Sheet Metal Solutions, LLC operates from Duluth, Minnesota, in the Lincoln Park Craft District. The company was established in 2013 when Becky and Mark LaTour left their previous jobs to launch the business as a Women Owned Small Business (WOSB). The LaTours built the shop around a simple premise: if a project involves metal, they can likely find a way to execute it.

The shop delivers a broad range of metal fabrication and HVAC services. Core processes include custom stainless steel fabrication (NSF/ANSI 2 certified for food‑service equipment), architectural metalwork, TIG and MIG welding performed both on‑site and off‑site, copper soldering, and dust‑collection system fabrication. They also handle full residential and commercial HVAC installation, service, and replacement—covering furnaces, air conditioning, rooftop units, make‑up air units, exhaust fans, and refrigeration. Additional capabilities span metal siding, gutters, downspouts, flashings, and custom shop fabrication for projects of varying scale.

The customer base spans commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Notable clients include Castle Danger Brewery in Two Harbors, MN, which relied on SMS for stainless fabrication; Nuss Truck & Equipment, which uses the shop for HVAC projects across Twin Cities locations; and the Black Woods Group (Tavern on the Hill), a restaurant and catering operator. The company also serves homeowners with remodels, new construction, and gutter work.

The founders emphasize employee retention and client satisfaction as differentiating factors. They describe their approach as flexible, with a willingness to accommodate special situations, and they guarantee satisfaction from start to finish. Being bonded and insured in both Minnesota and Wisconsin further supports their ability to work across state lines.
